channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula diz que não sabia que Bolsa Família não teve reajuste e se esquiva sobre caráter eleitoral
item.description: Lula stated he was unaware of the lack of adjustment to the Bolsa Família and that the recent announcement followed his discovery of the situation. In an interview with TV Globo, he avoided commenting on the electoral nature of the measure.

item.title: Lógico que estou preocupado com aumento da dívida pública, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula expressed concern about the growing public debt and advocated for economic growth as a way to address the fiscal challenge. He emphasized the need for policies that promote sustainable development to reduce indebtedness.

item.title: Lula diz que desconhecia falta de aumento no Bolsa Família antes da eleição
item.description: President Lula stated he was unaware of the lack of adjustment to the Bolsa Família during his third term and denied that the measure taken before the first round had an electoral character. He emphasized that the decision was made by government technicians without the intention of influencing the election.

item.title: Lula diz ser favorável à redução da maioridade penal para 16 anos para crimes hediondos
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated his support for lowering the age of criminal responsibility to 16 for heinous crimes, but ruled out including the proposal in the public security reform. He emphasized the need to discuss the matter separately and carefully.

item.title: Lula diz que Brasil deve chegar a um acordo com os EUA sobre tarifaço
item.description: Lula states that Brazil needs to negotiate an agreement with the US to prevent tariff increases on Brazilian products. He emphasizes the importance of maintaining balanced trade relations between the countries. The statement was made during a press conference on TV Globo.

item.title: Conselho dos Direitos Humanos pede a órgão da OEA monitoramento da eleição após decisões de Kassio no TSE
item.description: The National Council of Human Rights (CNDH) sent a letter to the IACHR alleging biased judicial decisions by Minister Kassio at the STF during the 2026 election runoff, claiming unequal application of electoral law. The council requests OAS monitoring of Brazil's electoral process.

item.title: Explicação de chefe da PF sobre festa de Vorcaro não me convenceu, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula criticized the director-general of the Federal Police, Andrei Rodrigues, for attending a party organized by Daniel Vorcaro abroad, stating that the explanation provided was not convincing. Lula emphasized that such involvement should not have occurred and questioned the transparency of the act.

item.title: A nova pesquisa Real Time Big Data sobre a disputa Flávio x Lula no segundo turno
item.description: A new Real Time Big Data survey will be released on October 20th, updating voter intentions for Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro ahead of the runoff on October 25th, including rejection rates, voter conviction levels, and potential vote shifts. The poll will also assess public opinion on proposals such as building federal prisons, labeling crime factions as narcoterrorist organizations, and lowering the age of majority.

item.title: Lula recorta a dos puntos la ventaja de Flávio Bolsonaro pero siguen en empate técnico ante las presidenciales
item.description: The 2026 presidential race remains tight, with Lula slightly ahead of Flávio Bolsonaro in a technical tie according to recent polls. Lula's campaign accuses Meta of favoring Bolsonaro on digital platforms.

item.title: Lula diz que PCC e CV “são terroristas para a comunidade brasileira”
item.description: President Lula stated that PCC and Red Command are terrorists for the Brazilian community but do not fit the category of state terrorism. He criticized Trump's designation and advocated for cooperation between Brazil and the US in fighting organized crime.

item.title: Lula na TV Globo: como o petista se saiu na entrevista? Veja as notas e avaliações dos colunistas do GLOBO
item.description: TV Globo interviewed Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva on Thursday in a live broadcast after the news. Columnists described his performance as assertive and calmer, giving him an average score of 3.7.

item.title: Celina Leão: Lula evita entrar na negociação de empréstimo ao BRB por envolvimento com Vorcaro
item.description: Celina Leão claims Lula avoids negotiating a loan to BRB due to the involvement of the Palácio do Planalto with Daniel Vorcaro from Banco Master. The governor emphasized that the financial health of BRB does not depend on direct contact with the federal president.

item.title: Em live, Flávio ignora fim da 6x1 e foca em redução de maioridade penal
item.description: In a live session, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) downplayed the end of the 6x1 scale in the Senate and focused on lowering the penalty age to 16. The Security PEC, which included this change, was removed from the Senate agenda, and the vote postponed.

item.title: Datafolha anima petistas com queda pela metade na diferença com Flávio
item.description: The Datafolha poll released this week showed a significant reduction in the gap between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro, dropping from four to two percentage points. This boosted the PT campaign after a less favorable projection released following the second round. The new survey reinforces the competitiveness of the 2026 presidential race.

item.title: Bilenky: Datafolha capta mudanças em posições de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Datafolha polling shows Flávio Bolsonaro adjusted his stance in the second-round campaign, adopting a more explanatory tone after initially acting as if already in power. Thais Bilenky notes this shift on the A Hora program, Canal UOL.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro defende redução da maioridade penal e ironiza emenda do PT
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro advocated for lowering the age of criminal responsibility to 16 and 14 for heinous crimes, mocking the PT's proposal. He accused Lula of appropriating the Public Security PEC, despite it being originally proposed during his administration.

item.title: Em áudio, irmã de Vorcaro diz que banqueiro se sente ameaçado na prisão e quer contar tudo
item.description: In a leaked audio, Daniel Vorcaro's sister claims the former banker feels threatened in prison and wants to reveal all about alleged bribes involving high-ranking officials. Vorcaro is detained in Papudinha prison in Brasília and is negotiating a third plea bargain with prosecutors.

item.title: Desentendimento no PT ajudou a adiar votação da PEC da Segurança, diz José Guimarães
item.description: Minister José Guimarães stated that the postponement of the Security PEC vote was due to internal disagreements within the PT, with the opposition exploiting the party's fragility to suspend the session. The vote was delayed due to lack of consensus on amendments, and the government is working on a strategy to address the juvenile justice age separately.

item.title: CNBB critica redução da maioridade penal, defendida por Flávio
item.description: The CNBB reaffirmed its opposition to lowering the criminal majority age, emphasizing the importance of prioritizing the social reintegration of adolescents over harsher punishments. The initiative to reduce the age to 16, advocated by Flávio Bolsonaro and partially agreed upon by Camilo Santana, faces resistance from both the Church and the PT bureau. The religious entity stresses that the problem is not the legislation, but the lack of investments in education and social protection.

item.title: Datafolha: colunistas do GLOBO analisam a segunda pesquisa do instituto para o segundo turno entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The second Datafolha poll for the runoff between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro shows the PL candidate with 52% of voting intentions, against 48% for the PT candidate. Globo columnists analyze the numbers and discuss potential impacts on the electoral dynamics.

item.title: TSE dá 24h para Meta corrigir restrições a anúncios da campanha de Lula
item.description: The TSE ordered Meta to fix, within 24 hours, restrictions wrongly applied to Lula's campaign ads, under penalty of a R$500,000 daily fine. The ruling also requires ad replacements and investigation of suspected profiles and AI-generated content.

item.title: Líder do PT no Senado diz ter avisado Lula sobre apoio a proposta que reduz maioridade penal para 16 anos
item.description: The PT leader in the Senate, Camilo Santana, said he informed Lula about an amendment to lower the age of criminal responsibility for heinous crimes, included in the Security PEC. The initiative has support from 28 senators, including allies of Lula and opposition, but faces division within the government. The PEC was postponed due to lack of consensus, but Camilo emphasized the desire for swift approval.

item.title: Ruas se mobiliza por Flávio e para imprimir marca bolsonarista na futura gestão no Rio
item.description: Douglas Ruas (PL) won the Rio de Janeiro elections after the annulment of Anthony Garotinho's votes, solidifying bolsonarism in the state government. As coordinator of Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign in the state, he mobilizes digital influencers and right-wing leaders to expand support for the PL. The administration faces challenges such as public debt and organized crime, while prioritizing a national agenda aligned with Flávio.

item.title: Carta ao Leitor: A missão de fiscalizar os poderosos
item.description: VEJA's cover story reveals audio and documents in which Daniel Vorcaro claims he paid bribes to Lula and the Lula Institute as a 'toll' to obtain favors within the government. The investigation involves the former treasurer of the PT and Minister Alexandre Padilha, with evidence that officials opened doors to state pension funds and extended preferential treatment to the banker. Despite disinformation campaigns, the consistency of the facts and the truth of the investigation endured.

item.title: Alcolumbre retira PEC da Segurança da pauta: “Fiz o que queria fazer”
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre removed the Public Security constitutional amendment from the agenda due to lack of consensus within the PT regarding lowering the age of criminal responsibility. The decision comes amid internal government disputes and opposition pressure, with controversial amendments proposing to reduce criminal liability age to 16.

item.title: TSE manda retirar postagem de Flávio sobre possível mesada a Lulinha
item.description: The TSE ordered the removal of posts by Flávio Bolsonaro and Nikolas Ferreira linking Luiz Inácio Lula to allegations involving his son Lulinha in an INSS fraud investigation. The decision was made by majority, with justices Kassio Nunes Marques, Dias Toffoli, and Estela Aranha deeming the content unsupported by facts. The rapporteur André Mendonça voted to keep the posts, citing grounding in ongoing investigations and press reports.

item.title: TSE manda PT apagar post que atribui a Flávio cortes de R$ 250 bilhões
item.description: The TSE, by decision of Minister Marco Aurélio Bellizze, ordered the PT to delete a post attributing to Flávio Bolsonaro the announcement of R$250 billion in cuts, deeming the information potentially misleading. The decision is preliminary and requires removal within 24 hours, preserving the post's data.

item.title: Alcolumbre protege Lula ao tirar PEC da Segurança da pauta, diz Marinho
item.description: The president of the Senate, Davi Alcolumbre, withdrew the Public Security PEC from the agenda to avoid political confrontation with the Lula government ahead of the runoff. Opposition leader Rogério Marinho accuses Alcolumbre of protecting the PT, prioritizing electoral interests over public security.

item.title: Lula ou Flávio: quem está na frente no segundo turno em cada região do Brasil? Veja as últimas pesquisas
item.description: Datafolha and Quaest polls show a technical tie between Lula and Flávio nationally, with regional variations: Lula leads in the Northeast, while Flávio leads in the Southeast, South, and Center-West. The margin of error is two percentage points.

item.title: OpenAI aciona PF após identificar possíveis ameaças a Lula no ChatGPT
item.description: OpenAI reported potential threats against President Lula to the Federal Police and the Electoral Court after identifying concerning conversations in ChatGPT involving assassination plans and Nazi symbols. A user discussed detailed attack scenarios with a sniper rifle and far-right imagery during interactions with the AI chatbot.

item.title: Governador eleito, Cleitinho passa mal ao discursar no Senado e não participará do primeiro ato com Flávio em MG
item.description: The elected governor of Minas Gerais, Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos), fell ill after a speech at the Senate and had to cancel a campaign rally with Flávio in Capelinha. The medical team reported high blood pressure and heart rate, though tests came back normal. The incident affects the joint campaign schedule between the two elected allies.

item.title: “A picanha tá vindo de ônibus”, diz Flávio após Lula prometer passe livre
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro mocked Lula's promise of free weekend public transport, comparing the delay in implementation to meat that hasn't arrived yet. Lula announced plans to send a constitutional amendment to Congress, funded by parliamentary amendments, though no costs were disclosed. The race remains tightly contested, with polls showing a technical tie.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro refez o seu cálculo sobre o debate Band/Estadão
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro confirmed his attendance at the Band/Estadão debate after reevaluating his stance, as analyzed by Carlos Andreazza. The columnist noted the senator's campaign was stagnant, but the shift might aim to re-engage supporters in the runoff. This contrasts with his initial strategy to avoid public exposure.

item.title: Senado aprova ‘OAB da Medicina’
item.description: The Senate approved the bill converting the provisional measure making the National Exam for Medical Education Evaluation (Enamed) mandatory for medical students. Known as 'OAB da Medicina', the proposal was sent to Congress by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and ties professional licensing to exam performance.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula inverte placar com Flávio Bolsonaro e passa a liderar entre eleitores mais jovens
item.description: The latest Datafolha poll for the 2026 presidential race shows Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) overtaking Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) among voters aged 16 to 24, with 50% to 43%. Despite this shift among young voters, Flávio still leads in the Southeast and South regions, among evangelicals and men, while Lula dominates in the Northeast, among Catholics, women and low-income voters.

item.title: Redução da maioridade penal já estava no radar do governo Lula desde o início do ano
item.description: The Lula government discussed reducing the age of criminal responsibility from the start of the year. Senator Camilo Santana proposed an amendment for heinous crimes, surprising given the PT's historical opposition.

item.title: Logo será preciso teste de DNA para separar esquerda e direita
item.description: Difficulty distinguishing left and right by rhetoric; Bolsonarismo supported Lula's 6x1 policy, while Flávio Bolsonaro pushed for the minimum age reduction to block PT's agenda.

item.title: Mendonça encerra processo que tentava impedir ato convocado por Caetano
item.description: TSE minister André Mendonça dismissed a lawsuit attempting to block a democracy-themed concert organized by Caetano Veloso in Copacabana. The suit, filed by a state deputy candidate and a non-profit institute, claimed the event was a campaign rally for Lula. Mendonça ruled without examining the merits, citing lack of standing by the plaintiffs, and referred the matter to the Electoral Prosecutor's Office for review.

item.title: A face feminina da direita: quem vota e quem chega ao poder
item.description: Women represent the majority of the Brazilian electorate, accounting for 52.84% of eligible voters in 2026. However, there is significant diversity in political preferences, particularly among those identifying with the right, which has heavily influenced electoral outcomes, as seen in the 2022 and 2026 elections.

item.title: Governo Trump responde a congressistas sem dizer se respeitará resultado da eleição brasileira
item.description: The Trump administration responded to a letter from U.S. congress members regarding U.S. actions in Brazil but did not clarify whether it will respect the outcome of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election.

item.title: Lindbergh: Flávio ligou "modo desespero" ao acionar TSE contra sindicatos
item.description: Lindbergh Farias claimed that Flávio Bolsonaro acted in 'desperation mode' by filing a lawsuit with the TSE against left-wing unions and social organizations, including MST and UNE, accusing him of trying to censor pro-Lula demonstrations. The deputy also criticized Flávio's allegations about pension cuts, as a judge rejected an injunction against the PL candidate.

item.title: Secretário da Saúde de Tarcísio, Eleuses Paiva pede para deixar gestão
item.description: São Paulo Health Secretary Eleuses Paiva requested to leave Governor Tarcísio de Freitas' administration. His departure was expected amid internal criticism, particularly over his son's unsuccessful election campaign. Luiz Carlos Zamarco is cited as a potential successor.

item.title: Na TV, Lula exalta fim da 6x1; Flávio promete Ministério da Prosperidade
item.description: Lula highlighted the approved end of the 6x1 shift in electoral ads as a government achievement. Flávio Bolsonaro, who voted in favor, avoids mentioning it in his campaign and previously opposed the measure. The amendment sets a 40-hour weekly cap without wage cuts.

item.title: Bolsa cai 1% e dólar sobe para R$ 5,087 com pesquisas do 2º turno
item.description: The Brazilian real weakened as the US dollar rose 1,17% to R$ 5,087 and the Ibovespa fell 1,06%, driven by 2-turn election polls and Senate approval of a 6-to-1 work scale. A Quaest poll showed a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (46%) and Lula (44%), with a 2-point margin of error. Markets await new polls and investor signals on fiscal and inflation risks.

item.title: “Não cederemos à chantagem”, diz líder do Governo sobre maioridade
item.description: Government leader Teresa Leitão (PT-PE) stated the administration will not yield to opposition pressure to include changes to the age of criminal responsibility in the Public Security Constitutional Amendment. The proposal will be voted on without amendments, per a prior agreement. The opposition, led by Rogério Marinho (PL-RN), submitted an amendment to lower the age from 18 to 16, which Leitão branded a delaying tactic.

item.title: Governistas se dividem sobre diminuição da maioridade penal em PEC da Segurança no Senado
item.description: Government party members in the Senate are divided over including the reduction of the criminal age to 16 for heinous crimes in the Public Security PEC. Camilo Santana, a Lula ally, supports the measure to counter an opposition proposal lowering it to 14, while some PT members prefer further debate. The deadlock may delay the PEC vote, which aims to create the Ministry of Public Security.

item.title: Ibovespa desvaloriza de olho em aprovação do fim da escala 6×1 e disputa eleitoral acirrada
item.description: The Ibovespa dropped 1.06% to 204,300 points, pressured by the approval of the 6x1 schedule and electoral uncertainty, with construction stocks leading losses and education and health stocks helping to cushion the decline. The market reacts to fears of a possible defeat of Flávio Bolsonaro, seen as a favorite for defending an orthodox fiscal policy, while the dollar rises to R$ 5.09.

item.title: CNBB diz que reduzir maioridade penal 'não enfrenta causas da violência nem oferece respostas duradouras'
item.description: The CNBB reaffirms its historical stance against lowering the age of criminal responsibility, arguing that such measures do not address violence and provide no lasting solutions. Amid the Public Security constitutional amendment debate, opposition parties propose amendments to lower the criminal age, but the CNBB advocates for investment in youth protection, education, and promotion instead of early imprisonment.

item.title: "Eleição de Lula vai afetar o Fundo Constitucional do DF", afirma Hermeto
item.description: District deputy Hermeto (MDB) claims a Lula victory in 2026 could lead to the federalization of Banco de Brasília and the dismantling of the DF Constitutional Fund, affecting health, education, and security. He criticizes the approval of the end of the 6×1 scale as an electoral maneuver and warns about potential changes in the STF.

item.title: Brazil Journal, IstoÉ e portais de esquerda; como Vorcaro montou rede de influência em sites de notícias
item.description: Federal Police messages reveal that Daniel Vorcaro, former banker, used sponsorships and investments from companies linked to him to build an influence network in news sites such as Brasil Journal, IstoÉ, and left-wing portals. The strategy aimed to shape media narratives and expand his political and economic influence. The case illustrates how public figures can use non-traditional communication channels for image manipulation and propaganda.
